title: El son nica
goal: Get a musician to explain what he is playing
culture: Musicians here are asked to play and almost never asked what it is. Asking is worth more to him than the coins, and toque otra is the best thing you can say to anybody holding a guitar.

beats.es: (Está tocando algo que usted no reconoce.)
beats.good: Ask. He is asked to play constantly and asked what it is almost never.

beats.es: Es son nica, pues. De aquí.
beats.good: De aquí again — the same two words the poet used about Darío in Parque Central, and meaning the same thing: the country, not the street.

beats.es: De aquí mismo. Mi papá tocaba esto.
beats.good: Toque otra — play another one. It is the best thing you can say to somebody with a guitar and it is worth more to him than the coins are.

beats.en: I liked that a lot. Thank you.
beats.good: Me gustó, in the past, because it is finished. Saying so out loud is the payment that is not money.
